# CredQ

CredQ is an Australian mortgage broking business helping clients with first home buyer loans, refinancing, investment loans, and borrowing power strategy.

## Core Services
- First home buyer guidance
- Refinancing strategy and lender comparison
- Investment loan strategy
- Borrowing power and loan structure clarity

## Service Area
- Australia (based in NSW)
